import models, schemas

def get_task(db: Session, task_id: int):
    return db.query(models.Task)\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.dependencies_as_prerequisite))\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.dependencies_as_dependent))\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.tags))\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.topics))\
        .filter(models.Task.id == task_id).first()

def get_tasks(db: Session, project_id: int, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100):
    return db.query(models.Task)\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.dependencies_as_prerequisite))\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.dependencies_as_dependent))\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.tags))\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.topics))\
        .filter(models.Task.project_id == project_id).offset(skip).limit(limit).all()

def create_task(db: Session, task: schemas.TaskCreate):
    task_data = task.model_dump(exclude={"assignee_ids", "promoter_ids", "tag_ids", "topic_ids"})
    assignee_ids = task.assignee_ids
    promoter_ids = task.promoter_ids
    tag_ids = task.tag_ids
    topic_ids = task.topic_ids
    
    db_task = models.Task(**task_data)
    
    if assignee_ids:
        users = db.query(models.User).filter(models.User.id.in_(assignee_ids)).all()
        db_task.assignees = users

    if promoter_ids:
        users = db.query(models.User).filter(models.User.id.in_(promoter_ids)).all()
        db_task.promoters = users
    
    if tag_ids:
        tags = db.query(models.Tag).filter(models.Tag.id.in_(tag_ids)).all()
        db_task.tags = tags
    
    if topic_ids:
        topics = db.query(models.Topic).filter(models.Topic.id.in_(topic_ids)).all()
        db_task.topics = topics

    db.add(db_task)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_task)
    return db_task

def update_task(db: Session, task_id: int, task: schemas.TaskUpdate):
    db_task = db.query(models.Task)\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.tags))\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.topics))\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.assignees))\
        .options(selectinload(models.Task.promoters))\
        .filter(models.Task.id == task_id).first()
    if not db_task:
        return None
        
    task_data = task.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude={"assignee_ids", "promoter_ids", "tag_ids", "topic_ids"})
    assignee_ids = task.assignee_ids
    promoter_ids = task.promoter_ids
    tag_ids = task.tag_ids
    topic_ids = task.topic_ids

    for var, value in task_data.items():
        setattr(db_task, var, value)
    
    if assignee_ids is not None:
        users = db.query(models.User).filter(models.User.id.in_(assignee_ids)).all()
        db_task.assignees = users

    if promoter_ids is not None:
        users = db.query(models.User).filter(models.User.id.in_(promoter_ids)).all()
        db_task.promoters = users
    
    if tag_ids is not None:
        tags = db.query(models.Tag).filter(models.Tag.id.in_(tag_ids)).all()
        db_task.tags = tags
    
    if topic_ids is not None:
        topics = db.query(models.Topic).filter(models.Topic.id.in_(topic_ids)).all()
        db_task.topics = topics

    db.add(db_task)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_task)
    return db_task

def delete_task(db: Session, task_id: int):
    db_task = db.query(models.Task).filter(models.Task.id == task_id).first()
    if not db_task:
        return None
    db.delete(db_task)
    db.commit()
    return db_task
